Phase 1 was written and hashed before any repair-comparison.patch was opened; Phase 1 content was not edited afterwards.

sentence_level_comments.finding: CAUSAL ACCOUNT IS INCOMPLETE AND PARTLY WRONG. It explains the November/December misclassification (unanchored numeric alternative in parseMonthPatterns.any), but the October failure has a different cause: matchMonthPatterns requires a suffix (十[二一]) so bare 十月 never matches at all, and the abbreviated numeric class 1[12] excludes 10. Those are missing alternatives, not a shorter token winning. An L4 packet whose diagnosis does not explain a defect the issue explicitly names is not a valid L4 instance.
